spans.s:
púṇya, a. prosperous; happy; lucky,
faustus, auspicious, 12^13, 591. 10; right,
good; as n. good work; sing. collectively,
good works, 28^17; merit (from good
works). [perhaps fr. √puṣ.]

púṇya-gandha, a. of good or pleasant
smell.

puṇya-pāpa, n. pl. good and bad deeds.
[1253a.]

puṇya-śloka, a. of good fame; as m.
Punyaśloka, epithet of Nala.
